architecture_debts: composite owned values and aggregate control-flow ownership
specialized collection identity versus parametric abstraction
semantic.py module scale and ownership/layout coupling
bounded developer tooling and self-hosting scope

selected_milestones.title: Composite Owned Values
selected_milestones.scope: owned bytes, text, vectors, maps, and sets in explicitly declared aggregates
environment_requirements: Linux native for descriptor ABI evidence
selected_milestones.risk: aggregate layout, partial construction, and cleanup ABI
selected_milestones.exit_criteria: normative aggregate ownership contract and hosted/reference gates pass

selected_milestones.title: Aggregate Move Borrow Drop Flow
selected_milestones.scope: path-sensitive ownership at joins, returns, early exits, and loops
selected_milestones.exit_criteria: verifier proves exactly-once cleanup on all valid paths

selected_milestones.title: Constrained Generic Functions V1
selected_milestones.scope: closed compile-time generic functions with deterministic monomorphization
selected_milestones.risk: code-size explosion and accidental trait system
selected_milestones.exit_criteria: constrained specializations are concrete before IR/Assembly

selected_milestones.title: Parametric Records and Enums
selected_milestones.scope: closed acyclic parametric aggregates with concrete specialized layouts
environment_requirements: Linux native for aggregate ABI evidence
selected_milestones.exit_criteria: parametric aggregates remain compatible with ownership and fixed-layout contracts

selected_milestones.title: Generic Ordered Vector V1
selected_milestones.scope: first generic ordered collection with explicit capacity and compatibility migration
environment_requirements: Linux native for concrete vector ABI
selected_milestones.exit_criteria: generic vector works without erasing closed specialized families

selected_milestones.title: Local Package Dependencies V1
selected_milestones.scope: local path and pinned Git revision dependencies with offline lock resolution
selected_milestones.risk: nondeterministic remote resolution and namespace collisions
selected_milestones.exit_criteria: locked dependencies build offline with identical identities

selected_milestones.title: Content-Addressed Incremental Builds
selected_milestones.scope: dependency-aware exact artifact reuse keyed by canonical content
selected_milestones.exit_criteria: warm builds reuse only exact compatible artifacts

selected_milestones.title: Language Server Protocol V1
selected_milestones.risk: second compiler front end and unbounded IDE scope
selected_milestones.exit_criteria: editor facts come from the authoritative compiler

selected_milestones.title: Canonical Source and Developer Experience
selected_milestones.risk: duplicate capability claims and documentation drift
selected_milestones.exit_criteria: a human can discover, build, test, and diagnose a small project predictably

selected_milestones.title: Bounded Self-Hosted Manifest/Test Reader
selected_milestones.scope: one bounded manifest or test-report reader with Python oracle and fallback
selected_milestones.exit_criteria: one useful bounded component has exact deterministic parity and safe fallback
